easyPrerequisites: Cheering Fanatic does not have summoning sickness.
description:
Declare Cheering Fanatic as an attacker.
Cheering Fanatic triggers, allowing you to choose "Conjurer's Bauble" and reduce the cost of spells with this name by {1} this turn.
Activate Emry by tapping it, targeting Conjurer's Bauble.
Cast Conjurer's Bauble from your graveyard by paying {0} due to Cheering Fanatic
Mirran Spy triggers, untapping Emry.
Activate Conjurer's Bauble by tapping and sacrificing it, allowing you to put up to one card from your graveyard onto the bottom of your library, and then causing you to draw a card.
